# Strygonia

> Strygonia builds precision bench instruments for embedded engineers.

## About

Strygonia is a hardware company that designs tools for engineers who work with embedded systems, PCBs, and microcontrollers. Founded by Sidak Mann.

Website: https://www.strygonia.com
Contact: contact@strygonia.com

## Products

### BlackBox (SG-BB1)
- Type: Hardware flight recorder
- Price: $198.99 (Founder's Edition)
- Status: V1 Prototype

BlackBox is a small module you clip onto a breadboard, Raspberry Pi, or custom PCB. It continuously records voltage (2 rails), current (high-side sensor), UART serial output, reset events, 4 GPIO inputs, and 1 analog channel, all timestamped against a shared clock in a rolling buffer. When your board faults, you connect via USB-C and scrub back through a desktop timeline app to see exactly what happened. No need to reproduce the failure.

Includes: BlackBox V1 recorder, color-coded wiring harness, USB-C cable, desktop timeline app (macOS, Windows, Linux).

Compatible with: STM32, ESP32, Raspberry Pi, Arduino, KiCad projects, custom PCBs, breadboards.
